mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% over the prior 3 months reduces the present value of expected equity cash flows, thereby depressing near-term S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during the identified rising rate period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) reduce consumer confidence and corporate hiring intentions, which lowers expected future earnings and drives down S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive with a Sharpe ratio exceeding 0.6 during the high-unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong demand growth that anticipates robust corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns in the following 5 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth rate exceeds 2% in a quarter while GDPC1 remains flat
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns underperform a 5-day risk-free rate by more than 10 basis points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests weakening manufacturing capacity, which suppresses earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) during INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 1%, it signals a shift toward accommodative policy, which boosts risk sentiment and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no outperformance versus a 60-day T-bill (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% triggers hiring acceleration in the services sector, elevating earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the post-tightening period.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising home sales (HOUST) indicate strengthening housing market demand, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are flat with a p-value > 0.5 during periods of rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of industrial production to capacity utilization (INDPRO / RSAFS) falls below 0.7, it indicates underutilized manufacturing capacity, which suppresses growth expectations and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) during capacity slack episodes.
